own_initiative: So Sovereign Cloud does not monitor customer content. Own-initiative measures are limited to abuse detected on our network (spam relays, phishing kits, open resolvers) and to acceptable-use violations reported by our security team.
automated_means: Automated systems flag network abuse (outbound spam volume, known phishing URLs). A person reviews every flag before any action on a customer account; no decision is taken solely by automated means.
training: Abuse desk staff complete onboarding training on the DSA, Swiss and EU data-protection law and our escalation procedure, with a yearly refresher.
